follow-up time: Postpartum period (defined as the period from delivery up to 1 year after delivery in the study)
exposure: Living in remote or rural areas
outcome: Maternal emergency department (ED) visits in the postpartum period
cohort: 255,929 pregnancies in Alberta, Canada between 2011 and 2017
finding: This retrospective cohort study found that almost one-third of postpartum ED visits occurred within 6 weeks after delivery and that several factors were associated with increased ED visits, including living in remote or rural areas, younger age, pre-existing health conditions, high parity, cesarean delivery, and intensive prenatal care.
mod_finding: Increased postpartum ED visits were associated with cesarean delivery (RR, 1.4; 95% CI, 1.4 to 1.4).
